judge.rationale: The candidate ignored multiple explicit instructions in the issue and invented its own protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`, and `ListSessionsMessage`/`SessionSummaryFrame`/`SessionListMessage` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`/`ConversationSummary`/`ConversationListMessage`). It also directly violated the requirement and acceptance criteria for missing `listFor`, returning an empty array (`sessions: []`) instead of adding `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` and returning an error frame. Furthermore, it completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` configuration, `StoreCannotList`, the 1–200 bounds check on `limit` (allowing `0` and `>200`), and the updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`. It also left a temporary `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository and made `sessionStore` a required argument to `createMessageHandler`, breaking existing unit test callers.
